systems.owner: Ministry of ICT and National Guidance

UGA.note: Names progress on an AI governance framework and an emerging technologies strategy, neither a national AI strategy adopted or drafted as such.
Makerere AI Health Lab and conference concern health AI, not digital policy research.
Only says progress on a National AI Governance Framework; no draft published, rule, authority or enforcement stated.
No government body's own AI use is described.
Mak Ocular is not stated to be piloted or in service in a public health system; the AI Health Lab is a research facility.

facts.fact: The Ministry of ICT article says Mak Ocular, a locally developed AI-powered mobile microscopy system built at Makerere University with a USD 1.5 million Google.org grant, automates diagnosis of malaria, tuberculosis and cervical cancer.

UGA.note: Names a Digital Transformation Roadmap only in passing; no standing, text, period, plan or reporting stated.
No government staff running or building systems is stated.
Conference reported; no named digital law or policy put to outside people.
